items.title: Stripe on Stripe: What we learned moving $1B in vendor payments to Global Payouts
items.blurb: In early 2026, we began moving our vendor payments to Global Payouts, Stripe’s product for paying recipients in 160+ countries. New-market setup fell from six weeks to one, with a 99.9% payout success rate. Here’s what we learned.
